summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments on the phase-39 branch (user-configurable vault parameters), then clean up follow-on issues raised by subsequent review rounds.
summary.outcome: All 15 review threads across 3 review passes were resolved; fixes were committed and pushed, tests pass, and dead code (useBinStore.retentionDays) was fully removed. A pinned axios lockfile was also committed to address a poisoned-version security incident.

repo: Phase 39 introduces user-configurable vault parameters: recycleBinRetentionDays (0-365, where 0 = immediate purge), maxVersionsPerFile, versionCooldownMinutes, deleteBehavior.
TEE IPNS key enrollment must follow the pattern in StorageTab.tsx when saving vault settings — wrap keypair in TEE enrollment before calling createAndPublishIpnsRecord.
DEFAULT_VAULT_SETTINGS in packages/core/src/vault/settings.ts is the canonical source of truth for defaults; validators should reference it instead of using literals.
useBinStore.retentionDays was a dead write-only field — the actual source of truth is now useVaultSettingsStore.settings.recycleBinRetentionDays.

The monorepo has a YAML formatting inconsistency in pnpm-lock.yaml between inline {key: value} and expanded block styles depending on which pnpm version regenerated it — functionally identical but produces large noisy diffs.
commit 560c871fe on docs/phase-38-context fixed a circular @cipherbox/core import in vault-ipns.test.ts that had not yet been merged into phase-39 branch.

code.finding: Hardcoded default literals (30, 10, 15, 'bin') duplicated DEFAULT_VAULT_SETTINGS; fixed to reference canonical object.
min clamp for recycleBinRetentionDays was 1; changed to 0 to allow immediate-purge semantics per D-03.
JSDoc said 'range: 1-365'; corrected to '0-365; 0 disables / immediate purge'.
Now reads retentionDays directly from useVaultSettingsStore, making the bin store field redundant.
retentionDays field and setRetentionDays setter removed entirely — dead code after vault settings store became source of truth.
setTimeout leak on unmount fixed with useRef + cleanup in useEffect return.
JSDoc still referenced hardcoded VERSION_COOLDOWN_MS; updated to document configurable cooldown via getVersionCooldownMs().
New test file created for deriveVaultSettingsIpnsKeypair (5 tests) rather than adding to vault-ipns.test.ts which had a pre-existing @cipherbox/core import resolution failure.
Test was asserting clamp(0) => 1; updated to expect 0 and renamed to reflect 0-is-valid semantics.

workflow: When merging main into a feature branch, always verify STATE.md and ROADMAP.md weren't overwritten with stale main values — merge doesn't know about in-progress phase state.
Stashing before merging main avoids losing unstaged review fixes during conflict resolution.
Verify all findings against current code before implementing — multiple rounds of review left several 'findings' already addressed by earlier commits in the same session.
CI failures on updated tests (min boundary changes) are expected when changing validation constraints — always update existing tests that assert old behavior.
pnpm lockfile YAML formatting churn from merges is cosmetic; only real content diff to check is package version specifiers (e.g., ^1.13.2 vs 1.13.2).
Use a separate test file rather than extending a file with a broken import, to unblock test runs without fixing unrelated issues.

friction: pnpm lockfile generated 15k lines of formatting churn after merging main, requiring manual investigation to confirm it was safe.
vault-ipns.test.ts had a pre-existing @cipherbox/core circular import failure that blocked running new tests in the same file — required creating a separate test file as workaround.
The fix for the circular import existed on phase-38 branch but wasn't merged into phase-39, causing confusion about whether the test failure was new.
Three consecutive review passes with overlapping/duplicate findings (setRetentionDays flagged in round 1, 2, and 3; min=0 range flagged in rounds 2 and 3) added overhead.
User had to manually interrupt a commit mid-flow to run pnpm lint:fix, suggesting linting should happen before commit automatically.
Axios poisoned-version incident required manual lockfile pinning (^1.13.2 → 1.13.2) outside normal workflow.
open_items: vault-ipns.test.ts circular import from @cipherbox/core is a pre-existing issue not fixed in this session — the workaround (separate test file) leaves the original file still broken.
keypair.privateKey zeroing after deriveVaultSettingsIpnsKeypair use was flagged but deferred as 'not applicable' — worth revisiting if a formal secrets-in-memory audit is done.
pnpm lockfile YAML formatting inconsistency between branches will continue producing noisy diffs until all contributors are on the same pnpm version.
Presets for vault parameter quick-select (VaultTab thread 5) explicitly deferred as a design simplification — may be revisited in a later phase.
